<script>

    function decideGreekInfo() {
        var userLang = navigator.language || navigator.userLanguage;
        if ($.cookie('GreekInfo') === undefined && userLang.startsWith('el')) {
            $('#grecomodal').modal();
        }
        return false;
    }

    function closeGreekInfo() {

        $.cookie('GreekInfo', '1', { expires: 365, path: '/' });
        $('#grecomodal').hide();
        window.location.href = "https://www.osculati.com/el";
        return false;
    }
    $(document).ready(function () {
        decideGreekInfo();
    });


</script>
